# One-Day Meal Plan for Endurance Cycling
**Athlete Profile:** 175cm, 68kg | Vegan, Gluten-Free, No Nuts

---

## NUTRITIONAL TARGETS
- **Calories:** ~2,800-3,000 kcal
- **Carbs:** 55-60% (385-450g) – fuel for endurance
- **Protein:** 15-17% (105-125g) – recovery & adaptation
- **Fat:** 20-25% (60-85g) – hormone function

---

## 🌅 BREAKFAST (7:00 AM)
**Quinoa & Berry Power Bowl**
- 1 cup cooked quinoa (222 kcal, 8g protein)
- 1 cup mixed berries (85 kcal, 1g protein)
- ½ cup soy milk (20 kcal, 2g protein)
- 2 tbsp ground flaxseed (110 kcal, 4g protein)
- 1 tbsp maple syrup (52 kcal)
- Cinnamon & salt

**Total: 489 kcal | 15g protein**

---

## 🥤 PRE-RIDE SNACK (10:30 AM – 1.5 hrs before ride)
**Carb-Loading Fuel**
- 2 rice cakes (140 kcal, 3g protein)
- 2 tbsp sunflower seed butter (190 kcal, 7g protein)
- 1 banana (105 kcal, 1g protein)
- Water

**Total: 435 kcal | 11g protein**

---

## 🚴 DURING RIDE (2-3 hour endurance session)
**On-Bike Fueling**
- Sports drink or water every 15-20 min
- Rice cakes or dates for carbs mid-ride (every 45 min)
- Electrolyte tablets for sodium replacement

---

## 🥗 LUNCH (1:30 PM – post-ride recovery)
**Lentil & Sweet Potato Buddha Bowl**
- 1.5 cups roasted sweet potato (103 kcal, 2g protein)
- 1 cup cooked red lentils (230 kcal, 18g protein)
- 2 cups mixed greens (14 kcal, 2g protein)
- ½ avocado (120 kcal, 1.5g protein)
- 2 tbsp tahini dressing (180 kcal, 5g protein)
- Lemon juice, garlic, salt

**Total: 647 kcal | 28.5g protein**

---

## 🍌 AFTERNOON SNACK (4:00 PM)
**Recovery Smoothie**
- 1 cup unsweetened oat milk (30 kcal, 2g protein)
- 1 scoop vegan protein powder (120 kcal, 20g protein)
- 1 banana (105 kcal, 1g protein)
- 2 tbsp pea protein powder (80 kcal, 16g protein)
- 1 tbsp maple syrup (52 kcal)
- Ice

**Total: 387 kcal | 39g protein**

---

## 🍝 DINNER (7:00 PM)
**Chickpea Pasta Primavera**
- 1.5 cups cooked gluten-free pasta (375 kcal, 8g protein)
- 1 cup cooked chickpeas (269 kcal, 12g protein)
- 1.5 cups roasted vegetables: broccoli, zucchini, bell pepper (90 kcal, 5g protein)
- 2 tbsp olive oil (180 kcal)
- Garlic, herbs, lemon

**Total: 914 kcal | 25g protein**

---

## 🌙 EVENING SNACK (9:30 PM – optional)

# One-Day Meal Plan for Rock Climbing Performance
**Goal: Lean muscle maintenance | 2,200-2,400 calories | High protein, plant-based, dairy-free**

---

## BREAKFAST (7:00 AM)
**Protein Pancakes with Berry Compote**
- 2 oat flour pancakes (made with chickpea flour, banana, baking powder)
- 1 tbsp almond butter
- ½ cup mixed berries with chia seeds
- 1 cup unsweetened almond milk

**Nutrition:** 420 cal | 16g protein | 62g carbs | 12g fat

---

## MID-MORNING SNACK (10:00 AM)
**Pre-Climb Fuel**
- 1 medium banana
- ¼ cup raw almonds
- 1 tbsp tahini

**Nutrition:** 280 cal | 10g protein | 28g carbs | 15g fat

---

## LUNCH (1:00 PM)
**Mediterranean Buddha Bowl**
- 1 cup cooked quinoa
- ¾ cup marinated tofu (baked)
- ½ cup roasted chickpeas
- Mixed greens, cucumber, cherry tomatoes
- 2 tbsp tahini-lemon dressing
- Nutritional yeast (2 tbsp)

**Nutrition:** 520 cal | 24g protein | 58g carbs | 18g fat

---

## AFTERNOON SNACK (4:00 PM)
**Post-Training Recovery**
- 1 serving plant-based protein smoothie:
  - 1 cup fortified soy milk
  - 1 scoop pea/rice protein powder
  - ½ frozen banana
  - 1 tbsp almond butter

**Nutrition:** 280 cal | 25g protein | 24g carbs | 8g fat

---

## DINNER (7:00 PM)
**Lentil & Vegetable Stir-Fry**
- 1 cup cooked brown lentils
- 2 cups mixed vegetables (broccoli, bell peppers, snap peas)
- 2 tbsp coconut oil for cooking
- 1-inch fresh ginger, garlic, low-sodium tamari
- Served over ¾ cup white rice

**Nutrition:** 480 cal | 18g protein | 68g carbs | 12g fat

---

## EVENING (Optional)
**Herbal tea + 1 oz pumpkin seeds**

**Nutrition:** 160 cal | 9g protein | 4g carbs | 13g fat

---

## DAILY TOTALS
| Metric | Amount |
|--------|--------|
| **Calories** | 2,140 |
| **Protein** | 102g (19% of intake) ✓ |
| **Carbs** | 244g (46% of intake) ✓ |
| **Fat** | 78g (33% of intake) ✓ |
| **Fiber** | ~38g ✓ |

---

## KEY NUTRITIONAL STRATEGIES FOR YOUR GOALS

✅ **Protein Distribution:** 20-25g per meal for optimal muscle synthesis  
✅ **High-Carb Around Training:** Banana pre-climb, smoothie post-climb  
✅ **Lightweight Protein Sources:** Tofu, lentils, legumes vs. heavy meats  
✅ **Micronutrient Density:** Fortified milks, nutritional yeast (B12), tahini (calcium/minerals)  
✅ **Hydration:** Add 2-3L water daily; electrolyte drink during climbing sessions

---

## PERSONALIZATION TIPS
- Adjust portions based on climbing intensity (±200 cal on heavy training days)
- Swap grains (quinoa ↔ farro ↔ millet) for variety
- Include B12 supplement or fortified foods daily
- Consider iron-rich meals with vitamin C (lentils + tomatoes) for optimal absorption
